facts.value: The origin of religion is uncertain. There are a number of theories regarding the subsequent origins of religious practices.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Religious Studies – Religion, Culture and Public Life

facts.value: Many of the great world religions appear to have begun as revitalization movements of some sort, as the vision of a charismatic prophet fires the imaginations of people seeking a more comprehensive answer to their problems than they feel is provided by everyday beliefs.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Religious Studies – Religion, Culture and Public Life

facts.value: The key to long-term success has relatively little to do with the prophets, but more to do with the development of a group of supporters who are able to institutionalize the movement.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Religious Studies – Religion, Culture and Public Life

facts.value: The development of religion has taken different forms in different cultures, with some religions placing emphasis on belief and others on practice.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Religious Studies – Religion, Culture and Public Life

facts.value: Some religions focus on the subjective experience of the religious individual, while others consider the activities of the religious community to be most important.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Religious Studies – Religion, Culture and Public Life

facts.value: Some religions claim to be universal, believing their laws and cosmology to be binding for everyone, while others are intended to be practiced only by a closely defined or localized group.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Religious Studies – Religion, Culture and Public Life

facts.value: In many places, religion has been associated with public institutions such as education, hospitals, the family, government, and political hierarchies.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Religious Studies – Religion, Culture and Public Life

facts.value: One thing religion or belief helps us do is deal with problems of human life that are significant, persistent, and intolerable.
facts.programme_association: Online Bachelor of Arts in Religious Studies – Religion, Culture and Public Life

facts.value: Religious beliefs accomplish this by providing a set of ideas about how and why the world is put together that allows people to accommodate anxieties and deal with misfortune.
